issues.detail: Spec leaves prev_in reset-cycle handling open; contract captures a 1 during reset paired with a 0 after release.
issues.spec_evidence: For each bit in a 32-bit vector, capture when the input signal changes from 1 in one clock cycle to 0 the next. "Capture" means that the output will remain 1 until the register is reset (active high synchronous reset).
issues.alternative: prev_in is cleared/ignored while reset is high, so reset-cycle 1s cannot cause capture after release.

issues.detail: capture_fall.uncertain is false while global uncertain lists reset-cycle prev_in behavior for capture_fall.
